description: This file defines and exports functions to fetch project cost data from an API. It contains two main functions: getProjectCost to retrieve the current cost of a project, and getProjectCostHistorySum to retrieve the total cost from cost-history data, both utilizing an API client.

methods.name: getProjectCost
methods.description: Fetches the aggregated current cost for a specific project from the backend API.

methods.name: getProjectCostHistorySum
methods.description: Fetches the total historical cost for a specific project, accounting for granular deltas, from the backend API.
